input.rationale: Section 12(b) gives us only a breach-of-contract indemnity from TrueLink: it covers "any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations." There is no third-party IP infringement indemnity anywhere in the Agreement, and no TrueLink non-infringement warranty that a breach-based indemnity could bite on (Section 2 addresses only TrueLink's own IP rights and Client's domain-name searches, and Section 12's disclaimer strips implied warranties). Because the vendor indemnity excludes IP infringement, the clause fails even the fallback position, which requires a vendor IP indemnity. The imbalance is aggravated by the very broad Client indemnity in 12(a) (Client breach, Client Content, Web Site, product/service injury). Redline adds IP infringement, breach of law, unauthorized access to Client Content, and gross negligence/willful misconduct to TrueLink's indemnity, plus standard notice/control/cooperation procedure; we left Client's indemnity in place as the smallest edit reaching the preferred position on vendor coverage.

proposal.summary: Expand TrueLink's indemnity to cover third-party IP infringement claims, breach of law, data/Client Content compromise and gross negligence or willful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity currently reaches only its own breach or non-performance, with no protection for us against third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Interface or the Hosting/Support Services, while Client's indemnity in 12(a) is very broad. We have added the standard supplier indemnity coverage (IP infringement, breach of law, unauthorized access to Client Content, and gross negligence or willful misconduct); if preferred, we can accept an IP-only indemnity with the usual exclusions for Client modifications, combinations and specifications.

ops.oldText: claim arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder.
ops.newText: claim arising out of (i) any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder; (ii) any allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any other materials or deliverables provided by TrueLink infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret or other intellectual property right of any third party; (iii) any breach by TrueLink of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (iv) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Client Content or other Client data caused by TrueLink; or (v) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of any claim, the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any obligation or admission on the indemnified party shall be made without its consent), and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense.
